composition: Use a strict 4:1 horizontal aspect ratio.
Apply either a 40/60 split layout (left 40% for emblem, right 60% for logotype separated by a 1px vertical line) or a 30% to 60% centered layout.
Frame the outer 15% edges symmetrically with dark, silhouetted palm trees, cityscapes, or blurred environmental elements.
Keep the background elements low-contrast to preserve a clean, empty negative space on the flanks.
typographie: Use bold, geometric, all-caps sans-serif or stylized cursive script for the primary title, occupying 30% to 50% of the canvas width.
Apply a secondary subtitle (e.g., 'ROLEPLAY') tracked out widely, positioned directly below the main title at 15% of its font size.
Apply a metallic silver gradient, a 3D bevel effect, or a solid white fill with a 1px stroke to the primary text.
Integrate the primary emblem directly into the typography (e.g., replacing a letter or acting as a central divider).
lumiere: Cast a strong radial glow or backlighting directly behind the central logo/emblem.
Apply soft, vibrant ambient light leaks (neon red, green, pink, or blue) emanating from the left and right canvas edges.
Use subtle rim lighting on the edges of the central vector elements to separate them from the dark background.
etalonnage: Use a high-contrast, deep black base paired with a single highly saturated neon accent color (#FF0000 red, #00FF00 green, #8A2BE2 purple, or #0088FF blue).
Maintain a monochromatic, desaturated, and dark color palette for all background elements.
effets: Mask a clean vector map texture or satin overlay inside the main emblem.
Apply a heavy background vignette and a soft depth-of-field blur to background silhouettes.
Add subtle finishing details: fine noise grain, floating embers/dust particles, or a solid 5px colored footer bar.
logo: Position the primary emblem either centered at 30% width or on the left at 40% width balanced by a horizontal logotype on the right.
interdits: Do not use default, unintegrated vertical dividing lines that look unpolished.
Avoid low-resolution background textures, muddy metallic gradients, or highly compressed starfields.
Do not make background silhouettes so dark that they degrade into compression noise.
Do not scale subtext or taglines below readable thresholds for low in-game resolutions.
Avoid placing text elements too close to the upper or lower canvas boundaries.
